notes.title: The Mansion EA - 24.09 Patch Note
notes.content:

notes.title: The Mansion EA - 16.04 Patch Note
notes.content:
We present you the third batch of fixes and additions to The Mansion Early Access! Please visit our forums and leave us your feedback :)

Additions:

 AZERTY keyboard option 
 A new small tutorial 
 The map is a little more accurate
 A minor gamepad changes

Gameplay:

 Dog food is now an active item (you will need it)
 Now you can (and have to) defeat the Tree Monster
 Alvin's "ghost" is now guiding you in a few places
 Draft new scenography is added outside The Mansion
 Skip option is now available during the fight with Alvin's demons
 Better keylocks usage
 Now the dog's behavior (and his chain) are more realistic

Other:

 Better object draw distance management

notes.title: The Mansion EA - 09.04 Patch Note
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38560435/4231156d1f37c70d21e4636c375445c595b9ef77.jpg

We're excited to present you the second batch of fixes and additions to The Mansion Early Access! Please visit our forums and leave us your feedback :)

Additions:
- Added postprocessing sharpening the graphics (can be turned off in options menu).
- New desing for the in-game text.

Gameplay:
- Added a few small, but important cutscenes and animations.
- Added a new lighting in the chappel with fire (let's call it 'a hint' ;) )
- Tweaks for using items.
- The meat has now new inhabitants, now you'll know why no one would touch it with bare hands.
- Added numorous new sound effects.
- The game won't save your progress if there is no light in the basement.
- Fixed the character blocking while puting in/puting out/turning poll cues in the columns.
- Graphics and lighting tweaks.

We are currently working on a next week's update with a new content:
- new battle with a Tree Monster!
- Alvin's ghost will have more influence on the gameplay.
- A lot of new animations and graphical elements.

notes.title: First patch
notes.content:
Here you are a brief list of fixes

General bugs:


 multiple fast actions problems fixed
 some objects shadow problem fixed
 lens flare effect improved
 some lamp issues fixed
 a lot SFX added/fixed (we know, a lot are still missing)


Puzzle fixes:


 A Ladder in the library is fixed as well as some strange behaviors of the box over the ladder
 "ghost door" in the library is fixed as well
 Postuments moving locked before activating mirrors in the Ball Room
 Opening previously open gates at the dog's cage fixed
 some box actions on the graveyard fixed
 some dumbwaiter issues fixed in the cellar
 a few strange cue actions avoided in the billiard room


Graphics improvements:


 better smoke over the tree in the orangery
 better lighting in a few places


and a lot of other minor changes/fixes; it's too boring to list them all
